## 3. Product Catalogues & Comprehensive Range

### A. Kundan & Meenakari Jewellery (Jaipur Specialty)
- **Description**: Traditional royal Indian jewellery featuring hand-cut glass polki stones, foil backings, vibrant enamelwork (Meenakari), and pearl droplet finishings.
- **Product Range**: Kundan choker sets, long rani haars, bridal necklace sets, maang tikkas, passas/jhumar, ear chains (sahare), and matching jhumkas.
- **Target Markets**: UAE (Dubai), USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indian diaspora wedding buyers.
- **Catalogue URL**: https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/kundan-jewelry

### B. Oxidised Silver & Tribal Boho Jewellery
- **Description**: Vintage antique silver finish cast in refined brass/alloy base with ghungroo bells, floral filigree, and ethnic motifs.
- **Product Range**: Oxidised silver chokers, tribal coin necklaces, heavy jhumkis, bohemian stack rings, nose pins, anklets, and kada bangles.
- **Target Markets**: Europe (France, Germany, UK), USA, Australia, and urban fashion boutiques.
- **Catalogue URL**: https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/oxidised-jewelry

### C. American Diamond (CZ) & Gold-Plated Fashion Jewellery
- **Description**: High-clarity cubic zirconia (CZ) stones handset in micro-pave copper/brass frames with 18k/24k real gold electroplating.
- **Product Range**: Modern CZ tennis bracelets, cocktail rings, pendant chains, minimalist ear studs, and office-wear jewellery.
- **Target Markets**: USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore, European boutiques, Amazon/Shopify sellers.
- **Catalogue URL**: https://www.gemoraglobal.co/products/american-diamond-jewellery

### D. Wholesale Bridal Jewellery Collections
- **Description**: Heavy 5-piece and 7-piece complete bridal jewellery sets designed for grand wedding functions.
- **Product Range**: Bridal choker, long neckpiece, matching earrings, maang tikka, nath (nose ring), and hathphool (hand harness).
- **Catalogue URL**: https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/bridal-jewelry

### E. Antique & Temple Jewellery
- **Description**: South Indian heritage temple design motifs, goddess Lakshmi coins, matte antique gold finishing.
- **Product Range**: Temple haars, waist belts (kamarbandh), coin bangles, and bridal temple sets.
- **Catalogue URL**: https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/antique-jewelry

- [Wholesale Bracelets & Bangles](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/bracelets): Anti-tarnish gold-plated bangles, kada sets, and adjustable bracelets.
- [Wholesale Rings](https://www.gemoraglobal.co/collections/rings): Statement cocktail rings, stackable rings, and American Diamond rings.

## 6. Quality Control, Finishing & Compliance Specifications

- **Anti-Tarnish Protective Lacquer E-Coating**: All plated jewellery pieces undergo an organic e-coating bath using electrical currents. This transparent seal protects against sweat, humidity, and oxygen, extending retail showroom shelf life to 12–18 months.
- **Chemical Safety Compliance**:
  - **Nickel-Free**: Plated in strictly hypoallergenic, nickel-free baths to prevent skin allergies.
  - **Lead-Free & Cadmium-Free**: Refined brass alloys tested to contain <0.01% lead and cadmium.
  - **Regulatory Certifications**: Complies fully with US Consumer Product Safety Improvement Act (CPSIA / Prop 65) and European Union REACH Annex XVII standards.

---

## 7. International Shipping & Customs Logistics

- **Air Freight Logistics Partners**: Express shipping via DHL Express, FedEx International Priority, and UPS.
- **Transit Time**: 3 to 5 business days delivery from Jaipur factory to doorsteps in USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, and Europe.
- **Customs Paperwork & Harmonized System (HS) Codes**:
  - **HS Code 7117.19**: Base metal imitation jewellery (earrings, necklaces, bangles, rings).
  - **HS Code 7117.90**: Other imitation jewellery (beaded, resin, fabric).
- **Documentation Package**: Every export shipment includes Commercial Invoice, Itemized Packing List, Certificate of Origin (COO issued by EPCH/Chamber of Commerce), ICEGATE Shipping Bill, and Airway Bill (AWB).
